intro: The field service pack, for installers, repairers, cleaners and anyone whose work happens at the customer's door: give jobs to technicians, follow them through the day, and finish each one on site with its checklist, parts, signature and payment. Switch the pack on in Organisation › Settings › Industry packs, for every place or only the ones that do this work.
start: Turn the field service pack on in Organisation › Settings › Industry packs, at the places that send out technicians.
Make a checklist for each kind of job in Field service › Checklists, so technicians know what to do on site.
Set your service areas, so each place knows where its technicians go.
Make your first job on Dispatch and give it to a technician.

articles.title: Make a job and give it to a technician
articles.summary: Say what is to be done, where and when, then give it to a technician from the waiting queue on Dispatch.

steps.rest: then press Make the job. It waits in the queue to be given to someone.

tips: A technician cannot have two live jobs at the same time. If the times overlap, you are told which job is in the way.
A job shows as late when its window has been open for a while and nobody is on site yet. How long that is comes from your settings.
Vans seen in the last half hour shows where your vans are now.

articles.title: Work through a job on site and finish it
articles.summary: Move the job along as the technician travels, answer each checklist step on site, take the signature and the payment, then finish it.

steps.rest: from Jobs or from the technician's row on Dispatch.

steps.lead: Answer each step of the checklist.
steps.rest: Press Tick it, enter a reading or a note and press Save, attach a photo with Use this photo, or take a part from the van's stock.
if the checklist asks for one, and press Save the signature.

steps.lead: Under Finish the job, enter the payment taken,
steps.rest: with its reference, or add lines to invoice the work on site.
If something is still missing, the page lists it first: a required step, the signature, or a payment or invoice.

tips: Steps can only be answered once the technician is on site.
A reading outside its allowed range raises a follow-up job when the job is finished.
A part is still recorded as used even when the van has none in stock; the van is put right at the end of the day.
Time on site goes onto the technician's timesheet when the job is finished, where your settings say so.

articles.title: Set up a checklist for a kind of job
articles.summary: List the steps a technician follows on site, and say whether the customer signs at the end. Each change is a new version.

steps.rest: on Checklists, and give it a name and, if you like, the job type it is for.

steps.lead: Tick The customer signs at the end
steps.rest: if you need a signature, then press Make the checklist. It can now be chosen on a new job.

steps.lead: To change it later, press New version,
steps.rest: make your changes, say what changed and save it.

tips: A job keeps the checklist version it started on, whatever the checklist becomes later.
